notes.title: Update on April 12th
notes.notes:
Bug fix fixes signal configuration errors for two facilities
Bug fix fixes conflicts between broom and warehouse buttons
Box selection: Add batch deletion option
Improve aerial view

notes.title: Update on April 7th
notes.notes:
Bug fix fixes errors caused by cleaning in certain situations

Bug fix fixes errors caused by copying and pasting in certain situations

Bug fixes: In some cases, deleting settings may result in residual items

Bug fix fixes player log files that are too large due to rendering warnings

Add pause function

Auto close switch button when prompted to add a new level

Thank you to all players for their suggestions and opinions

notes.title: Release EA version
notes.notes:
It is with some trepidation that the first EA version is finally released.
As it is an EA version, the game still has a lot of shortcomings, so if you don't particularly want to experience this game, please also add a wishlist so that the game can be purchased after the official release.
If you find any bugs in the game or if you have any suggestions or comments, please also give me feedback!

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Fix a bug that caused an error while continuing the game
This bug may cause players to make errors when re reading files after exiting the game, resulting in the inability to play normally.
If you discover any new errors or bugs, please contact us
